## Services & Pricing (ILS)
Three fixed packages — no standalone à la carte add-ons:
- BMS Classic: ₪199 (full exterior wash, windows inside and out, interior vacuum, dashboard and surfaces, door jamb cleaning; arrival fee not included)
- BMS Silver: ₪399 (everything in Classic, plus wheel and tire cleaning, exterior plastic restoration, full interior vacuum with pet hair removal, 2-week paint protection spray; arrival fee included)
- BMS Gold: ₪649 (everything in Silver, plus engine bay cleaning, headliner cleaning, spare tire bay cleaning, plastic and leather restoration, fabric shampoo for seats and carpets; arrival fee included; most comprehensive package, recommended before selling a car)

- Recommended frequency: every 3–6 months (3 months for daily drivers, families, outdoor parking)
